meta.name: customer-journey-map
meta.description: Create a customer journey map across stages, touchpoints, actions, emotions, and metrics. Use when diagnosing a broken experience or aligning a team on the full customer flow.

copy.tagline: 绘制客户旅程地图，诊断体验断点并统一团队认知
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要可视化客户全流程并发现体验问题
copy.tagline_en: Map customer journeys to diagnose experience gaps and align your team
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to visualize the full customer flow and identify pain points

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按步骤创建客户旅程地图，覆盖从认知到忠诚的各个阶段，记录客户行为、触点、情绪、KPI、业务目标和涉及团队。
howto.when: 当你需要诊断客户体验问题或对齐跨团队对客户流程的理解时，可以要求 Claude 创建客户旅程地图。

say.text: 为我们的B2B SaaS产品创建从注册到首次价值实现的客户旅程地图。
say.note: Claude 会引导你填写各阶段细节。

say.text: 帮我画一个客户旅程地图，角色是产品经理，场景是评估我们的技能仓库。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤生成表格。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you step-by-step to create a customer journey map covering stages from awareness to loyalty, documenting customer actions, touchpoints, emotions, KPIs, business goals, and teams involved.
howto.when_en: Use when diagnosing a broken customer experience or aligning a team on the full customer flow. You can ask Claude to create a customer journey map.

say_en.text: Map the customer journey for our B2B SaaS onboarding from signup to first value.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through each stage.

say_en.text: Create a journey map for a PM evaluating our skills repo from discovery to loyalty.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a table step by step.
